Class RequestedContentTypeResolverBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.reactive.accept.RequestedContentTypeResolverBuilder
public class RequestedContentTypeResolverBuilder extends Object
Builder for a composite RequestedContentTypeResolver that delegates to other resolvers each implementing a different strategy to determine the requested content type -- for example, Accept header, query parameter, or other.

使用构建器方法按所需顺序添加解析器。对于给定的请求，将使用第一个返回非空列表且该列表不仅由 `MediaType.ALL` 组成的解析器。

默认情况下，如果没有显式配置解析器，构建器将添加HeaderContentTypeResolver。
